channel.title: Night At The Museum
channel.desc: Comedy 2006 Larry Daley thinks landing a night guard job at a museum promises stable, easy work, until he discovers the unexpected. After the gates close and the crowds vanish, he's left alone, with the exhibits, cursed to awaken after sunset. Ben Stiller, Carla Gugino, Ricky Gervais, Robin Williams, Mickey Rooney, Shawn Levy, Milan Trenc, Robert Ben Garant.
